title: Outfit Gap for Upcoming Weather
dataSources: Wardrobe items (`wardrobe:item`), outfit wears (`outfit:wear`), skincare routines (`skincare:routine`), laundry cycles (`laundry:cycle`).
app: Wardrobe and grooming logs — closet apps (Whering, Stylebook), cost-per-wear trackers, skincare-routine logs, and smart-laundry cycles — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=outfit:wear weather_band=*
| stats dc(outfit_id) as outfit_options by weather_band
| where outfit_options<5
| sort outfit_options
description: Shows weather bands where you have too few proven outfits for the conditions you actually face.
value: Wardrobe gaps are clearest when tied to real weather needs rather than abstract style aspirations.
implementation: Tag outfit wears with weather bands and count distinct outfit options per band.
visualization: Table of weather bands with distinct outfit options.
grandmaExplanation: It watches which kinds of weather leave you short on outfits that already work.
